# AI wiki

This repository is a Markdown wiki of practical guidance for developers using AI agents, mostly GitHub Copilot. It is not an application.

- Write and edit pages to `STYLE.md`: give every recommendation its reason, give each action a Copilot example, and cut hedges.
- Check the audience and scope in `DESIGN-GOALS.md` before substantive changes.
- Agents that make changes: follow `AGENTS.md`, which has the full working instructions and checks.
